title: Butter Garlic Chicken
description: Butter Garlic Chicken is a popular Indo-Chinese dish featuring crispy fried chicken tossed in a rich, buttery garlic sauce with green chilies, aromatic herbs, and black pepper. Creamy, savory, and packed with bold garlic flavor, it pairs perfectly with fried rice, noodles, or Indian breads.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Marinade
items: Boneless chicken – 500 g, cut into bite-sized cubes

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the chicken with ginger-garlic paste, black pepper powder, and salt.
Cover and marinate for at least 30 minutes for maximum flavor.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Fry the Chicken
steps: Lightly coat the marinated chicken with refined flour.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the chicken pieces for 6–8 minutes until golden brown and fully cooked.
Transfer to a paper towel to drain excess oil.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Butter Garlic Sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a clean pan over medium heat.
Add the diced garlic and sauté until fragrant and lightly golden.
Stir in the chopped green chilies and cook for about 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in the refined flour and cook for another 30 seconds, stirring continuously.
Gradually whisk in the chicken stock until smooth and lump-free.
Season with black pepper, Italian seasoning, and salt.
Simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish the Dish
steps: Add the fried chicken to the butter garlic sauce.
Toss gently until every piece is evenly coated.
Finish with lime juice, chopped coriander, and spring onions.

chefTips: Use unsalted butter and adjust the seasoning at the end for better flavor control.
For a richer restaurant-style sauce, stir in 1–2 tbsp fresh cream before adding the chicken.
Cook the garlic until lightly golden—not dark brown—to avoid bitterness.
Freshly prepared chicken stock provides the best flavor and body.
Serve immediately after tossing to keep the chicken crispy.
